standard-dialogue-talking-without-the-co.npc: What brings you to these parts, stranger?

steps.player: What is this place?

steps.npc: I suppose it is a little different to the places your type are used to...
This is my humble little hideaway! Plenty of fish around to sustain a man like me, with the help of my trusty cormorant.

steps.player: A bird helps you to fish?

steps.npc: Sure she does! I haven't used a rod in years, just send her out to the waters and she takes care of it for me!

options.text: Could I have a go with your bird?

steps.player: Could I have a go with your bird?

steps.npc: These birds can be a lot of work... I'm not sure you could handle them, let alone to catch a fish!

steps.text: You need 43 Fishing and 35 Hunter to go aerial fishing.

steps.npc: I don't know, I doubt that your type's up to the task...
But it would be quite the amusing sight. Go on!

steps.text: If the player does not have anything equipped in gloves or weapon slot.

steps.npc: I'll keep an eye on you and make sure you don't have too much trouble with her!

steps.player: What's in the sack?

steps.npc: Oh, this? This is my trusty old fish sack!

steps.player: Fish sack?

steps.npc: Yeah, fish sack! I might sell you one if you've found any of those pearls around here.

steps.text: Alry the Angler's Angling Accessories store opens.
steps.target: Alry the Angler's Angling Accessories store

steps.player: No thanks.

options.condition: If the player has a golden tench in their inventory:

steps.player: I found this big fish...

steps.npc: Now that is a biggun! How she managed to wrangle one like that I'll never know.
If you don't want it, I could take it off your hands for a few of those pearls!

steps.player: I'm interested... How many pearls are we talking?

steps.npc: I'll give you a hundred pearls for it. What do you say?

steps.prompt: Trade in your golden tench for 100 molch pearls?

steps.player: On seconds thoughts, I'd rather keep it.

steps.npc: As you wish.

steps.player: It's a deal.

steps.npc: Pleasure doing business with you!

steps.player: No thanks.

steps.npc: Well, let me know if you change your mind.

steps.player: About feeding the bird... Do I have to cut up the fish for it?

steps.npc: Yes, she likes her food chopped up.

steps.player: But she could eat them whole in a pinch?

steps.npc: I suppose, but you wouldn't want me to catch you feeding her that way.

steps.text: If the player has less than 20 Molch pearls in their inventory:

steps.player: Of course, I'd never do such a thing.

steps.text: You could bargain better if you had some pearls.
If the player has at least 20 Molch pearls in their inventory:

steps.player: What if I were to... Sweeten the deal.

steps.text: You flash a handful of pearls.

steps.npc: I do like pearls...
I'll do it for 20 of them.

steps.player: Here you go.
I'm afraid that's a little too steep for me.

steps.npc: Then get out of my sight!

standard-dialogue-talking-without-the-co.npc: Ah, it's you. Listen... There's something I need to tell you.
I overcharged you for the fish sack. I set that price for your type because I've found most of you arrogant.
Adventurers! But as I was saying, you've proved to have a real passion for the craft. I was wrong.

standard-dialogue-talking-without-the-co.player: Oh, right. Well, thanks for coming clean.

standard-dialogue-talking-without-the-co.npc: I'd like to make things right. Here you go.

standard-dialogue-talking-with-the-cormo.npc: Ah, it's you. How are you finding things?
Yes, your type do often seem to underestimate it! Are you finished?

options.text: Not yet. I think I'll keep trying.

steps.player: Not yet. I think I'll keep trying.

steps.npc: Just come back and let me know when you get tired!

options.text: Yeah, I'll try again another time.
